condition: Only if every executable design is exactly execution-equivalent to the frozen incumbent
limitation: Prior confirmation reuse is explicitly reported, not advertised as a fresh 400-sample ablation.
novel_design_rule: Non-equivalent proposals still require their own paired screen and independent confirmation under the original margins.
rationale: Identical executable reward/configuration under fixed runtime cannot have an instruction-specific quality difference. Repeated generation under different labels is not a causal Skill replicate.
rule: Use retained frozen 400 paired validation attempts plus the new 100 paired smoke attempts; do not regenerate an identical reward solely under a different Skill label.
timing: Before reading fresh screen outcomes and before all literal Designer responses are available
